topics.name: Simple past for telling a story

options: The elf is smallest than the mouse.
The elf is smaller than the mouse.
The elf is more small than the mouse.
questions.rule: To compare two, add -er to a short adjective and use than: smaller than.

questions.prompt: Pick the sentence with the correct plural.
options: Two thiefs hid in the forest.
Two thieve hid in the forest.
Two thieves hid in the forest.
questions.rule: Many nouns ending in -f change to -ves: thief - thieves.

options: Once upon a time, a kind farmer live in a village.
Once upon a time, a kind farmer living in a village.
Once upon a time, a kind farmer lived in a village.
questions.rule: Once upon a time starts a story in the past, so use the simple past: lived.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: Yesterday shows the past. The past of write is wrote.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: Two needs a plural noun. The plural of child is children.
We live on an island.
than compares two, so use the -er form: taller than.

questions.prompt: Make a sentence for a magic story.
questions.rule: Who + did what (past) + to what: The magician waved his wand.

chat: What did you write in class today?
options: I writed a story about a brave robot.
I wrote a story about a brave robot.
I written a story about a brave robot.
questions.rule: write is irregular: write - wrote - written. Use wrote alone for the past.

chat: How many characters are there in your story?
options: There are five characters in it.
There is five characters in it.
There are five character in it.
questions.rule: More than one: There are + plural noun: five characters.

questions.prompt: Pick the sentence with the correct preposition.
options: The king's party starts on seven o'clock.
The king's party starts at seven o'clock.
The king's party starts in seven o'clock.
questions.rule: Use at with clock times: at seven o'clock.

options: Raju is the intelligentest scholar in the kingdom.
Raju is most intelligent scholar in the kingdom.
Raju is the most intelligent scholar in the kingdom.
questions.rule: Long adjectives take the most: the most intelligent. Never add -est to them.

questions.prompt: Pick the sentence with the correct plural.
options: The mice ran across the kitchen floor.
The mouses ran across the kitchen floor.
The mices ran across the kitchen floor.
questions.rule: mouse has an irregular plural: mice.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: the ... of all compares one with many, so use -est: the cleverest.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: For two people or things, use between. among is for more than two.
Last night is past time. The past of find is found.
sheep stays the same in the plural: one sheep, ten sheep.

questions.prompt: Make a sentence about a place.
questions.rule: Use on with an island, and an before a vowel sound: on an island.
We say in space, like in the sky.

chat: Did the superhero save the city?
options: Yes, he save it just in time.
Yes, he saved it just in time.
Yes, he did saved it just in time.
questions.rule: Use the simple past saved. After did we would use the base form (did save), never did saved.

options: Sonu is the forgetfullest boy in our class.
Sonu is the most forgetfuller boy in our class.
Sonu is the most forgetful boy in our class.
questions.rule: Long adjectives like forgetful take the most: the most forgetful.

questions.prompt: Pick the sentence with the correct verbs.
options: The brave school girl caught the thief and called the police.
The brave school girl catched the thief and called the police.
The brave school girl caught the thief and call the police.
questions.rule: Both actions are past: caught (irregular) and called.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: Long ago shows the past. The past of hide is hid.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: knife changes -fe to -ves in the plural: knives.
With two people or things, use between.
the ... I have ever read compares with all others, so use -est: funniest (y changes to i).
Thing + is + -er adjective + than + other thing.

questions.prompt: Make a sentence for a mystery story.
questions.rule: Plural people take their. thief - thieves, knife - knives.

chat: Who is braver, the dog or the cat?
options: The dog is bravest than the cat.
The dog is braver than the cat.
The dog is more braver than the cat.
questions.rule: Two things: braver than. Don't use more with an -er word.

chat: What happened at the end of your story?
options: The detective finded the thief and the people cheered.
The detective found the thief and the people cheered.
The detective found the thief and the people cheers.
questions.rule: Tell the whole ending in the past: found (irregular) and cheered.

options: The farmer and his dog was very loyal friends.
The farmer and his dog were very loyal friend.
The farmer and his dog were very loyal friends.
questions.rule: Two subjects joined by and take were, and the noun after is plural: friends.

options: The queens crown was stolen by a sly thief.
The queen's crown was stolen by a sly thief.
The queen's crown was stole by a sly thief.
questions.rule: Show who owns something with 's: the queen's crown. After was, use stolen.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: two pilots is plural and last week is past, so use were.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: last night is past. The past of sleep is slept.

questions.after: dinosaurs lived on the earth long ago?
questions.rule: Use how many with things we can count: how many dinosaurs.

questions.after: silly mice are always talking to each other.
questions.rule: mice is plural, so use these. this/that go with one thing.
Past question: Wh- word + did + subject + base verb: Where did the thief hide ...?
Ali's robot (owner + 's) is smaller than mine.

chat: Whose idea was the dinosaur story?
questions.rule: Whose asks about the owner. Answer with 's: Kabir's idea.

chat: Which story type did your group choose?
options: We chosen a mystery because we love solving puzzles.
We chose a mystery because we loves solving puzzles.
We chose a mystery because we love solving puzzles.
questions.rule: Past choice: chose. A thing we always like: we love (no -s with we).

options: The wiser of the three scholars quietly solved the king's riddle.
The wisest of the three scholars quietly solved the king's riddle.
The wisest of the three scholars quietly solve the king's riddle.
questions.rule: For one out of three or more, use -est: the wisest of the three.

options: Twenty years from now, robots will cooks our food and clean our houses.
Twenty years from now, robot will cook our food and clean our houses.
Twenty years from now, robots will cook our food and clean our houses.
questions.rule: Robots in general is plural: robots. After will, use the base verb: will cook.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: Last night and looked are past, so the second verb is past too: found.

questions.prompt: One word is wrong. Find it and fix it.
questions.rule: of all the acrobats compares one with many, so use the highest.

questions.before: The story moves from a hill fort
questions.after: a big city two hundred years from now.
questions.rule: Moving between two places: from ... to ....
foot has an irregular plural: feet.
A story often starts with a time phrase + comma, then who did what in the past: ruled.

questions.prompt: Make a sentence about a hero.
questions.rule: the + -est adjective + noun + in + place: the bravest pilot in our city.

chat: I chose a mouse, a robot and a king.
options: I chose two elfs, a farmer and a pilot.
I chose two elves, a farmer and a pilot.
I choosed two elves, a farmer and a pilot.
questions.rule: elf - elves (f to ves). choose - chose in the past.

chat: Was your story funnier than ours?
options: No, your was much funnier than ours.
No, yours was much funnier than ours.
No, yours was much funniest than ours.
questions.rule: yours stands alone for your story; funnier than compares two stories.
